background_story: Erin, a renowned archaeologist, had always been fascinated by the ancient civilizations of North Africa. Her latest obsession was the Libyan city of Leptis Magna, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Born and raised in the United States, Erin's interest in Libyan culture was sparked by her grandmother's stories of her time as a diplomat in Tripoli. Erin spent years studying the history and language of Libya, eventually leading an expedition to uncover the secrets of Leptis Magna. Her team made groundbreaking discoveries, shedding new light on the city's importance in the Roman Empire. Erin's passion for Libyan history and culture earned her the respect of her peers and the admiration of the Libyan people, who welcomed her as a friend and a champion of their heritage.
